articles.title: Trump: "We eliminated their nuclear weapons, we can take care of the remaining sites in ten minutes"
articles.description: United States President Donald Trump declared that Iran's nuclear program has been eliminated, but said there are still one or two sites that need to be addressed.Trump added: "We can do it in ten minutes. Ten minutes. We have the plans for it."
